description: Open-web method: 10 captured English/Bengali prompts, broad monthly and four weekly December windows, garment/labor, sculpture-policy and election searches, event follow-ups and November/January boundary leads. Sources cover Dhaka and national/regional story discovery. Search is not LexisNexis; no search totals/native timestamps; not exhaustive.
required_followup: Use accessible regional archives for any material unresolved event; do not infer no protests from results.

description: The 30 December BNP rally occurred and has an explicit state election demand, but no participant count is reported.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous attendance estimate and event end/response; do not infer from police presence or traffic.

description: The 11 December government-official program gathered several thousand in Dhaka, but the article describes opposition to vandalism/pro-state statements and does not clearly direct a demand to Bangladesh government. Related New Age follow-up page returned HTTP 403; no content was used.
required_followup: A permitted independent source is needed to resolve whether the program demanded state action/policy and whether its campaigns form one episode. No retry to the restricted exact URL.

description: September and December reports describe A-One/Tazreen worker claims across months, but no November-specific gathering or continuous public assembly is established; private wage claim alone does not qualify.
required_followup: Find dated public actions and explicit state-policy demands; resolve onset before placing any action in December.

description: No independent scientific reviewer examined current evidence hashes; proposed/pending states are not verified provisional. Official baseline remains pending.
